modmenu.summaryTranslation.mehburs_minim: A client-side 3D minimap with color-coded entity dots, an animated full-screen map and death markers.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mehburs_m: A client-side 3D minimap with color-coded entity dots, an animated full-screen map and death markers.
message.mehburs_minimap.death_marker_rem: Death marker removed until your next death
config.mehburs_minimap.title: Mehbur's Mini Map Settings
config.mehburs_minimap.map_size.tooltip: In GUI units, so the size on screen also follows the game's GUI Scale.
config.mehburs_minimap.zoom.tooltip: Higher values show less ground in more detail.
config.mehburs_minimap.north_locked.tool: On: north stays at the top. Off: the map turns with you.
config.mehburs_minimap.auto_cave_mode.to: Shows tunnels instead of the surface underground and in the Nether.
config.mehburs_minimap.simplify_distant_: Prevents wave patterns on flat ground. Off keeps sharper detail.
The line under the FPS. Servers that hide debug info also hide this.
config.mehburs_minimap.big_map_zoom.tool: The mouse wheel changes this while the big map is open.
config.mehburs_minimap.show_mobs.tooltip: Passive, neutral, hostile and boss dots.
config.mehburs_minimap.show_items.toolti: Dots for items on the ground.
config.mehburs_minimap.show_arrows.toolt: Bars for arrows and tridents in flight.
config.mehburs_minimap.show_ender_pearls: Dots for thrown ender pearls and eyes of ender.
config.mehburs_minimap.death_line_enable: A white line from you to your last death. Its key in Controls toggles it too.
config.mehburs_minimap.death_triangle_en: Off hides them for good. The remove key in Controls only removes them until your next death.
text.cloth-config.quit_config_sure: Are you sure you want to quit editing the config? Changes will not be saved!
